newsitem.title: USA: Swift Energy to drill 13 wells in venture.
newsitem.headline: Swift Energy to drill 13 wells in venture.

text.p: Swift Energy Co said it planned to drill 13 oil wells in the Giddings Field, Fayette County, Texas in 1997 under a joint venture with Union Pacific Resources Group Inc.

The agreement covers about 10,000 acres in Fayette County and Swift has about 8,500 additional acres located south to southeast of that area where it is drilling a test well called Uhyrek No. 1-OL. Swift also said it had completed the drilling of Fourticq No. 1-OL, a confirmation well.

It said the dual horizontal well produced at a rate of 13.8 million cubic feet of natural gas and 552 barrels of 57 degree API gravity condensate per day on a 20/64 inch choke from the Austin Chalk formation with a flowing tubing pressure of 6,300 psi.
The calculated absolute open flow rate was in excess of 60 million cubic feet per day during the initial flow period, it added.

Swift said it was the operator of the well, owning a 33.2 percent working interest. Union Pacific Resources owned 50 percent, while the remainder was owned by Swift-managed entities and other parties.
Swift is an independent oil and gas company engaged primarily in the exploration, development, acquisition and operation of oil and gas properties, with an emphasis on domestic natural gas.
